recognize_zh: 肝臟切片中淋巴球不在門脈區聚集，而是沿著竇狀隙 (sinusoids) 排成一串（黃色箭頭），CD3 陽性、CD5 缺失、CD8 部分陽性，這種竇狀隙分布的異常 T 細胞是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤 (HSTCL) 的特徵。
features: Panel A (H&E): mildly dilated hepatic sinusoids containing small clusters of medium-sized lymphocytes aligned in single file (arrowheads)
Panel A: hepatocyte plates preserved with pale, clear to finely vacuolated cytoplasm; no portal-based infiltrate or mass lesion in this field
Panel B: CD3 highlights numerous intrasinusoidal lymphocytes in a linear, branching pattern
Panel C: CD5 is essentially negative in the sinusoidal cells, with only rare positive cells (loss of pan-T antigen)
Panel D: CD8 shows partial positivity in the sinusoidal lymphocytes
describe_en: Core liver biopsy shows preserved lobular architecture with mildly dilated sinusoids containing an increased number of medium-sized lymphocytes distributed in an intrasinusoidal, single-file pattern, without a portal-predominant infiltrate. By immunohistochemistry, the sinusoidal lymphocytes are CD3 positive with loss of CD5 and only partial CD8 expression. The CD3+ cells markedly outnumber CD5+ cells, indicating an aberrant T-cell population. Findings are suggestive of hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with TCR gamma-delta (or alpha-beta) staining, cytotoxic markers, flow cytometry and cytogenetics (isochromosome 7q, trisomy 8) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Viral hepatitis shows mixed CD8+ T cells that retain CD5 and usually has portal and lobular inflammation with hepatocyte injury.
T-LGL cells are small with azurophilic granules and typically CD8+/CD57+ with preserved or dim CD5, and marrow involvement is interstitial rather than a predominant hepatosplenic sinusoidal pattern.
NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3 negative (cytoplasmic CD3ε only) and EBER positive.

ddx.dx: Hepatic involvement by other peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS usually forms portal-based or mass-like infiltrates of pleomorphic cells rather than a monotonous sinusoidal pattern.
